name: Andean Community

flag.description: A white field with the community's gold emblem below the centre: a half-disc arch enclosing a stepped pattern.
flag.symbolism: The stepped motif is drawn from the patterns of indigenous Andean textiles.

hook: The Andean Community is almost all white, with a low golden half-circle full of stepped patterns, like a sunrise over Andean stairs.
trivia: The community began as the Andean Pact under the Cartagena Agreement of 1969.
Chile, a founding member, withdrew in 1976, and Venezuela left in 2006.
